feeds.title: reimaginED
feeds.description: reimaginED is the policy and public affairs communications platform for Step Up For Students, a state of Florida-approved nonprofit scholarship-funding organization that helps administer four scholarship programs for Florida K-12 students. Our mission is to examine and report on how expanded education choice options are transforming K-12 education in Florida and beyond.

feeds.title: Teaching in the Heart of Florida Blog
feeds.description: I'm Rissa, author, and creator at Teaching in the Heart of Florida. I'm passionate about creating instructional resources that engage and challenge students and give teachers their time back! During my teaching career, I taught 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 5th grade and then had the opportunity to coach teachers for four years. Teaching and learning are what I love - whether it's coaching a teacher or helping a student. Checkout my blog for the latest news and resources.

feeds.title: EdTech K 12 Magazine » Florida
feeds.description: Stay updated on the latest news about education in Florida. EdTech: Focus on K-12 explores technology and education issues that IT leaders and educators face when they're evaluating and implementing a solution. It is published by CDW which is headquartered in Vernon Hills, Ill. CDW is a leading multi-brand technology solutions provider to business, government, education, and healthcare organizations in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Canada.

feeds.title: More Time 2 Teach Blog
feeds.description: My name is Melissa Yglesias and I teach 3rd grade in sunny Florida, where I've lived pretty much my entire life. I'm that teacher that's willing to do whatever's necessary as long as it means that my students are learning! Let's uncover what's overwhelming you, find solutions, and get you excited about teaching.

feeds.title: Florida College Access Network Blog
feeds.description: Florida College Access Network (FCAN) is at the heart of a movement to ensure all Floridians have the opportunity to achieve an education beyond high school and prosper in our dynamic economy. We strive to achieve the State of Florida's SAIL to 60 goals: for at least 60% of Florida adults to hold degrees and workforce-relevant credentials by 2030.

feeds.title: Education Week » Florida
feeds.description: The latest education policy news and instruction trends from Florida, including articles, opinion essays, data, and videos. Since 1981, Education Week has been America's most trusted resource for K-12 education news and information. 1.6+ million readers. We strive to provide national coverage.

feeds.title: Center for Creative Education Blog
feeds.description: Hear from the motivated professionals that carry out the mission of bringing arts and education to children and the community. Center for Creative Education serves students, teachers, and families by transforming educational environments through creativity and the arts.

feeds.title: Score At The Top Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated on the latest information & tips to get you ahead in your academic career. Score At The Top comprises several family-owned, full-service Learning Centers and schools throughout Palm Beach and Broward Counties. For over 30 years, we have provided an integrated array of academic support and guidance services to students of all ages.

feeds.title: JRA Educational Consulting Blog
feeds.description: Stay updated on the latest information & tips to get you ahead in your academic career. For over 30 years, we have provided an integrated array of academic support and guidance services to students of all ages. We are proud to be the only such family of personalized Learning Centers/schools accredited by SACS CASI.

feeds.title: Florida Citizens Alliance Blog
feeds.description: As a nonprofit, FLCA's mission is to improve Florida's K-12 education by uniting and empowering teachers, students, and parents. Our mission is promoting legislative action, engaging local communities with our kids' first teams, and providing alternative education resources through our Liberty Scholar initiative.
